name: EKIM TURIZM TICARET VE SANAYI A.S.
summary: EKIM TURIZM TICARET VE SANAYI A.S. engages in leasing, purchase, and sale of all types of motorized and non-motorized land, air, and sea vehicles in Turkey. It offers long-term operational land vehicle leasing, provides services including maintenance, repair, insurance, replacement vehicles, roadside assistance, and vehicle transfer; sale of used vehicles returning from operational leasing, and operational vessel (superyacht) chartering. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey.
